plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere from the dashboard: pair and revoke devices, set up and unlock the Session Vault, no terminal needed
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-4446 (sibling: Session Vault from the dashboard)

metadata.sizeJustification: The Session Vault half of the issue was split into sibling PAN-4446 (blocked by PAN-4307). What remains is one vertical feature: a trusted-origin store, two routes in one new route file, and three frontend components mounted in one new Settings section plus the Health page.

narratives.Problem: Pairing and device revocation work only through `pan pair` / `pan devices`, and adding the address other devices use (OVERDECK_TRUSTED_ORIGINS) needs a terminal and a dashboard restart. The server routes for pairing and devices exist (PAN-3762) but have no screens, and nothing in the dashboard tells the operator whether this machine is reachable, how many devices are paired, or what state the Session Vault is in.
narratives.Proposal: Add a persisted trusted-origin list (~/.overdeck/trusted-origins.json) merged into getTrustedOrigins() in every launch mode, a root-session-only POST /api/anywhere/trusted-origins, and GET /api/anywhere/status (machine identity, addresses, active device count, vault state, and problems with fix actions). Build Settings -> Anywhere with a Devices panel (list with scopes and last seen, in-app-confirmed Revoke), a Pair-a-device dialog (address pick/add, pairing link, QR, expiry), and an Anywhere status card also shown on the Health page. The dashboard calls the same pairing/devices routes the CLI calls. Session Vault setup/join/unlock/sync controls ship in sibling PAN-4446, in PAN-4307's Settings -> Session Vault section; the card links there.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Session Vault setup, join, unlock, passphrase and Sync now from the dashboard (sibling PAN-4446)
- A vault lock action, and dashboard-driven vault key rotation
- Removing or editing saved trusted addresses from the UI
- Changing `pan pair` / `pan devices` output, or adding a trusted-origin CLI verb
- The Access Tokens Settings section and the require_token_mint toggle (PAN-4435)
- Browse copies and Continue here (PAN-4436, PAN-4437)
- Automatic endpoint discovery (PAN-4403) and the TTS daemon's OVERDECK_TRUSTED_ORIGINS read
- Letting a paired device, an access token or the internal token (pipeline agents) create pairing links or add trusted addresses
- Any UI text that tells the operator to run a `pan` command

autoDecisions.summary: Split the Session Vault half into sibling issue PAN-4446, blocked by PAN-4307; PAN-4445 keeps devices, trusted origins and the status card.
autoDecisions.rationale: The combined scope exceeds the plan-size gate (more than 25 files, more than 6 subsystems), and the vault half builds on files that the unmerged PAN-4307 (PR #4444) adds, while this half depends on nothing in flight. The full vault design is in the PRD's sibling section.

autoDecisions.summary: Vault setup controls go into PAN-4307's Settings -> Session Vault section, not a second vault panel under Anywhere.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4307 already adds a state-aware session-vault section; two vault panels would duplicate a surface. The Anywhere card links to it with requestSettingsSection('session-vault').

autoDecisions.summary: Persist saved trusted origins in ~/.overdeck/trusted-origins.json and merge them into getTrustedOrigins() in every launch mode.
autoDecisions.rationale: config.yaml writes go through the capped settings-api.ts and PAN-4435 is adding dashboard.* keys concurrently; a dedicated file avoids both, and merging outside the bare-launch branch keeps Traefik/env launches trusting saved origins.

autoDecisions.summary: Only the root session may add a trusted origin; internal token, devices and scoped tokens get 403. Loopback origins are refused.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors PAN-2351 D-11 for pairing credentials and makes 'never exposed to pipeline agents' mechanically checkable, since agents hold only the internal token. Loopback origins are already trusted for this port.

autoDecisions.summary: Define 'unlock' as joining with the passphrase or recovery phrase on a machine whose backend is configured but whose key is missing or retired; there is no lock action.
autoDecisions.rationale: No `pan vault unlock` verb exists; the vault key is a file, and deleting it to 'lock' would be destructive.

autoDecisions.summary: The rotation-pending problem has no fix button; it states the fact and links the docs.
autoDecisions.rationale: Dashboard-driven key rotation is a separate, rare, high-risk operation outside this issue's scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend configuration/remote-access.mdx instead of creating a configuration/anywhere.mdx page.
autoDecisions.rationale: remote-access.mdx is already the Configuration page for pairing and devices; the root anywhere.mdx is the plans-and-pricing page.

autoDecisions.summary: Use qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT, zero dependencies, ships types) for the QR code, rendered as a data-URL .
autoDecisions.rationale: No QR library exists in the repo; this one is small, typed and avoids innerHTML.

autoDecisions.summary: Vault state for the status card uses openVaultContext() when PAN-4307's src/lib/vault/open.ts is on main, otherwise readVaultConfig() + key.next + loadVaultKey().
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps this issue independent of PAN-4307's merge order while giving the same states once it lands.

items.title: Persist saved trusted origins and merge them into getTrustedOrigins()

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create src/lib/remote-access/loopback.ts (import-free isLoopbackOrigin, the body of pan pair's isLoopbackBase) and have src/cli/commands/pair.ts re-export it as isLoopbackBase. Create src/lib/remote-access/trusted-origins.ts with trustedOriginsPath(), normalizeTrustedOrigin(), readSavedTrustedOriginsSync() (documented sync caller: getTrustedOrigins) and addSavedTrustedOrigin(raw, alreadyTrusted) writing {version:1, origins} atomically via temp file + rename. In origin-validation.ts add the saved origins to the set immediately above the NODE_ENV development block, outside the !hasEnvOriginConfig branch, and export invalidateTrustedOriginsCache(). Write the tests listed in WI-1.

items.title: Given an empty OVERDECK_HOME, when addSavedTrustedOrigin('https://desk.tailnet.ts.net/some/path', []) runs, then it returns { ok: true, origin: 'https://desk.tailnet.ts.net', added: true } and trusted-origins.json persists that origin; a second call returns added: false
Given 'http://localhost:3011', 'ftp://x' or 'not a url', addSavedTrustedOrigin returns { ok: false } with reason 'loopback' or 'invalid' and writes no file
Given a saved origin and OVERDECK_TRAEFIK_ENABLED=1 in the environment, getTrustedOrigins() returns a list that includes the saved origin

Given getTrustedOrigins() was already cached, when a new origin is saved and invalidateTrustedOriginsCache() is called, then validateOriginHeaders with that Origin on a POST returns { ok: true } without resetting env
tests/unit/cli/pair.test.ts passes unchanged, and isLoopbackBase is exported from pair.ts as a re-export of isLoopbackOrigin
